reviews.author: Eternally Thankful
reviews.text: Roughly two years ago, Joe Cool installed a Daiken unit and replaced old air ducts at our residence.  We opted to pay a monthly fee that covers a system check every 6 months. He treat us with respect and truly cares that we are satisfied with products and/or services provided.  I hope the management team at Joe Cool recognizes what a valuable employee they have.  If he were under my employ, a raise would be in order! 😉

reviews.author: brittany anello
reviews.text: Joey took the time to really explain everything in full detail and educated my husband and I on the full process. He was very professional and extremely knowledgeable. The installation manager was very attentive to his crew and the crew did such a fantastic job! It was a great experience. The whole entire team was fabulous!! I highly recommend this company!! They exceeded our expectations!!!

reviews.author: ES Santiago
reviews.text: Dale came and conquered my mother kitchen pipe and bathroom. He was super personable and over all so nice! Did what was needed and was very honest! Wish o could give him more than 5 stars

reviews.author: Geoffrey Zureikat
reviews.text: I never write bad reviews or say anything negative about anyone, but my experience was so bad that I would be doing everyone a disservice if I didn’t mention it. I had a very minor leak in a valve under my sink. The rep came out and was very nice but said it would be $500 to replace the valve. As someone in the real estate profession I know that price is grossly above market and the fact that they charge $90 to come out and give a ridiculous quote doesn’t feel right. I would only call this company if you like wasting money or really enjoy overpaying

reviews.author: Susie Cooke
reviews.text: Jacob came out the morning we called because our heat pump had iced up. Since it was the coldest morning of the year so far we were very happy he arrived so quickly. He was very professional and personable and diagnosed our problem right away. He gave us a thorough explanation, in simple terms, of the issue, and several options for how it could be handled. He was knowledgeable and courteous, and gave us some tips on keeping our unit running more smoothly which we really appreciated. The next time the unit needs serving we will definitely ask for Jacob. He has a great attitude, and we appreciated his candor.

reviews.author: Janet Chappel
reviews.text:
Elijah from Joe Cool was our technician.  He was on time, very personable and communicative.  He provided a detailed review of our three heating and cooling units and then identified where immediate repairs were necessary and other areas that we should consider for later repairs.  He didn’t pressure us to do any work that he didn’t consider immediately necessary and offered the option for a consultation with a heating expert.  We recommend Elijah and Joe Cool highly.

Janet and Larry Chappel

reviews.author: Emily Miranda
reviews.text: Joe Cool Air always does such a good job! Justin did an amazing job explaining things to us. He was very thorough, precise, friendly, and knowledgeable. I will be calling again. The responded quickly and got a tech to the house quickly.

reviews.author: L. T.
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Ashley Griffin

reviews.author: Andrea Pittman

reviews.author: Toar Fitzpatrick
reviews.text:
My best impression from this company, I have to lay squarely at the feet of my service tech Santiago Gonzalez. reviews.author: Kevin St. John

reviews.author: Michele McKee

reviews.author: jennifer metzger
reviews.text: Everyday Plumber is the best!  When we noticed a leak in our hot water heater we thought we would be in for a long wait for someone to get out. Ryan was very professional, knowledgeable, helpful and perhaps one of the nicest people we have met.  He was very thorough and explained everything to us in detail.  He was able to replace our hot water heater in less than a few hours and we had hot water almost immediately!  He left the area cleaner than when he arrived which we were very thankful for (we had just painted the walls and door the previous day).  He even cleaned out the area with a wet/dry vac before he installed the new one!  Again, one of the kindest, efficient and professional plumbers we have dealt with and will definitely be referring them to everyone in our neighborhood.  Thank you again for everything!

reviews.author: Kenya Saenz
reviews.text: This morning I called Cole in New Tampa to fix a shower's water control diverte valve. He was very punctual,  professional and knowledgeable.  The job was completed same day and it looks and works great!! Thank you very much, Cole.

reviews.author: Connor Morse
reviews.text: Everyday Plumbers were great. Walter and Ryan were able to take care of 2 separate jobs (one inside, one outside) the same day. Would highly recommend to anyone in the area. Walked me through all the issues and took care of each one with quality repairs. Thanks!

reviews.author: nineska del rosario
reviews.text: Ryan and Cole were professional and diligently communicated with me. They repair a leak and installed a new water heater efficiently. reviews.author: Allyson Vail

Cole came over immediately and not only diagnosed the root cause of our problem but also bought us some time with the services he provided that we needed. I highly recommend using Everyday Plumbing!

reviews.author: Kaylie Horning
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Jermaine Mitchell

reviews.author: Lewis Rollins

reviews.author: susan massey
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Michael B
reviews.text: My Wife Judy called clean Plumbing to deal with a backup in our master bathroom. They came out in a very timely manner within 1 to 2 hours the very same day of the call, just as promised. Jason, was our technician. We were very pleased with their customer service and knowledge far more than some of the other big companies that we had used in the past who seemed to send us less interested or less skilled technicians. We are happy to give a five star review because they earned every star.  We recommend them and would definitely use them in the future.

reviews.author: Kenny Brown
reviews.text: Kyle with Clean Plumbers was able to repair our water softener. He was friendly, quick, and efficient. He diagnosed out issue and he had what he needed on his truck for the fix. I appreciate the great help and being able to come on the morning that I called in.

reviews.author: Debbie Hammerberg
reviews.text:
If there were 10 stars we would have given this company and our plumbing technicians, Steve and Enrique a 10 Star rating.  The company lives up to their name, they are truly the clean plumbers. We would recommend the Clean Plumber Company to everyone that needs plumbing work done.

reviews.author: Kevin Brownell
reviews.text: We hired The Clean Plumbers to hook up a gas line to our dryer and connect a new gas stove to our existing gas line. From start to finish, the experience was excellent. Highly recommend The Clean Plumbers and will definitely be calling them again for any future plumbing or gas line needs!

reviews.author: Dottie Nott
reviews.text: The young man that came out and repaired our issue. Was knowledgeable, professional, did his job quickly and cleaned up after himself. I've saved their number to share or for future use. Thank you for a job well done. And our dogs liked him too

reviews.author: Thomas Kennison
reviews.text:
Great work on installing my entire piping system from meter to all fixtures. Very prompt service and professional crew.

No reply as to when the city completed inspection and if it passed. I also had to bury the exposed pipes and meter after inspection was completed a month later. When I was promised that your company was going to do these tasks. But overall great job and I still recommend your services.

reviews.text: We woke up to find a broken sprinkler pipe and had to shut off our water. After trying another company with no luck, we found Matt’s on Google and gave them a call. reviews.author: Stephen North
reviews.text: We are very pleased with the work done by Jason and Phillip. They fixed leaks, installed new piping (re-plumbed the house), and did the prep work for our new shower. Both men were friendly, knowledgeable, and hard-working. Matt's Plumbing Services cares about getting the job done right! We will not hesitate to call them again! A thank you to the owner Jake, too!

reviews.author: Haitham “HyPe” Abdel - Rahman
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with Matt's Plumbing Company, and I can't say enough good things about the experience. From the moment I reached out, Ricardo was incredibly professional and understanding of my financial situation. He worked out a deal for me that made it possible to finally address a persistent leak in my garage. This kind of customer service is rare, and I am truly grateful.

The installer, Austin Ford, was absolutely fantastic. He arrived on time, and his friendly and courteous demeanor instantly put me at ease. Austin is not only knowledgeable and skilled, but he also took the time to explain everything to me, ensuring I understood the process and what needed to be done. He was incredibly clean and respectful of my home, leaving the work area spotless after completing the job.

After months of dealing with a "garage river," I’m thrilled to say it has finally run dry thanks to Austin’s excellent work! It's clear that both Austin and Ricardo take pride in their work and customer service. If you're looking for a reliable plumbing company with top-notch service, I highly recommend Matt's Plumbing Company, Austin Ford, and Ricardo. Thank you both for the outstanding service and for helping me during a challenging time. You’ve earned a customer for life!

reviews.author: Ceil Constante
reviews.text: Highly Recommended!  I accidentally dumped soapy water with a barber comb in the toilet Friday.  I went to Home Depot and bought a plunger and snake and was told what to do by an associate.  I felt uncomfortable doing anything further because it didn't work.  I am REALLY GLAD I called Matt's! Monday morning 8 am Chad S, a master plumber of 17 yrs. put me at ease.  He explained everything and with PROFESSIONAL Equipment was able to remove the comb. He further told me the damage I could have done with the plunger.  If needed, I'd call them in the future.

reviews.author: Mrs.
reviews.text: First time using Matt’s Plumbing Service. We just moved here and do not know any plumbing services. So I just went down the Google search calling plumbers for assistance.   First let me say they are the only Plumbing service that actually answered the phone. That ended up being a blessing.  Jake Came out and did an amazing job!! Very honest, showed up on time, and is extremely fair in his pricing.  He is also a veteran.  I wouldn’t call another plumber for anything else I have to have done. I highly recommend their services. You will not regret it!

reviews.author: Steven Mears
reviews.text: Jacob F. from Matt’s Plumbing Services is outstanding. He provides fast, friendly service at very fair prices and is incredibly knowledgeable. What really sets him apart is his willingness to explain different options and approaches clearly, making sure you fully understand before moving forward. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Louis Boncek
reviews.text:
Ricky was well spoken and clear about the work necessary.

That's just not how it's done.

reviews.author: The Cake Girl
reviews.text:

Highly recommend DAM Plumbing!! They are true professionals from start to finish.

reviews.author: Anthony Serrano

reviews.author: Ryan Pelky
reviews.text: I called them yesterday to unclog my house and had a great experience with them from start to finish.  I bought an older house in south tampa which has a ton of plumbing problems. The technician quoted me a price to pull the toilet and run a snake through the toilet pipe.  He cleaned the drain and then ran a camera to locate where the pipes ran.  He discovered roots growing through the pipes and showed me on the screen.  He also informed me that we have cast iron pipes under the house and provided quotes to fix both.  I highly recommend these guys.

reviews.author: J Roach

reviews.text: Excellent response and service from Olin Plumbing.  From the communication with the office to the technician it was a very positive experience.  Jesus G was timely and professional. I felt the cost of their services was very reasonable considering all they had to deal with.  Thank you Jesus and Mark.

reviews.author: Katie Grimm
reviews.text: Olin plumbing has been great! We called them back after another plumbing company came and did work, then left us with pipes that needed replaced. David has also helped us before and was so good at treating my home and our situation as if it was his own.

reviews.author: Melanie Colon
reviews.text:
I cannot recommend Olin Plumbing highly enough!

We recently had a major plumbing issue where nothing would flow through our drain line. Water kept backing up, and we were getting increasingly frustrated trying to figure out what was causing the problem. We had another plumbing company come out first, but they weren't able to accurately diagnose the issue. Instead, they recommended replumbing a large portion of our home, which would have been a very expensive project. Something about that recommendation didn't sit right with me, so I decided to get a second opinion.

A friend recommended Olin Plumbing, and I'm so glad they did.

Mark came out and within just a few minutes, he seemed to have a solid understanding of what was actually happening. The very next day, Jesus arrived, snaked the drain, and recommended hydro jetting to fully clear the blockage. A few days later, Jesus and Zeke returned and thoroughly jetted the completely blocked line, successfully breaking apart and removing the buildup that had been causing all of our problems.

Not only did they solve the issue, but they also took care of some pipes that needed to be repaired and capped properly.

The relief we felt when the problem was finally resolved was incredible. Olin Plumbing saved us from spending tens of thousands of dollars on a major replumbing job that turned out to be unnecessary. Their expertise, honesty, and problem-solving skills made all the difference.

Everyone we interacted with was professional, friendly, and genuinely helpful. Thank you, Mark, Jesus, Zeke, Marty, and the entire Olin Plumbing team for your excellent service. It's rare to find a company that combines technical expertise with such outstanding customer care.

reviews.author: Chris Wooley
reviews.text: Everyone I dealt with at Olin Plumbing was fantastic. The person who took my call brightened my day with her kindness. David C. and Anthony D. came out that afternoon to give me an estimate on moving the shutoff valves and drain line for a bathroom remodel. The estimate was very reasonable, and they were able to complete the job that same day. They did a great job, cleaned up, and gave me some helpful tips on hooking everything up. reviews.text:

All in all, it was an excellent experience. I will keep Olin's phone number and Jesus's name at the top of my list of service providers. Next time I need a plumber, Olin will be my first call.

reviews.text: Was told the tech would be here between 12 and 4. Arrived at 5:40. Needed to repair a leaking valve in the toilet tank, which I’d bought a new gasket for. Then “rebuilt “ the tank as well as replace the gasket in the line to the wall. He quoted me $643.00 with my 5% discount. After I paid he emailed the invoice. $299 of the bill was for turning off the water at the street and turning on an outside faucet. He made it sound like a big deal when he quoted me. I called the office for an explanation and was told the manager didn’t have time to speak to me but would call by the end of the day. Didn’t happen. I think $299 to turn off the water is completely overpriced and should have been part of the $299 I was charged for the valve fix. My son showed the bill to a plumber who had done work for his company and they said this should have been $350 max. That’s also what I found on the internet once I saw the little work he did. Should have called another company to get a comparison quote. Beware their pricing. Also he only replaced part of the tank innards. Called it a tank rebuild.  Update: After seeing their response, I emailed the address they posted. That was 3 days ago and there has still not been a response. reviews.author: Kayla Dupuis
reviews.text: We first purchased our water heater with Benjamin Franklin back in 2019, a couple years later (2022) our water heater went out, they came and replaced it charged me almost $500 even though they weren’t supposed to. Was able to get that taken care of and refunded. Fast forward to (2026) Monday May 18th our water heater was leaking. Called to see if it was under warranty, they said they had to send someone out to go over that with me. Tuesday May 19th they came out, saw it was leaking and advised we would need a new one - again. They told us they no longer sell Rheem and they would have to call the manufacturer to see if they could get us one, or we could purchase a Bradford white that they sell now. Our options were $873 for labor  for another Rheem, $2200 for a Bradford White and 6 year warranty or $3200 for a Bradford white and 10 year warranty. I explained why would I want a new one and a few years down the road you switch manufacturers again and then I’m in the same boat. We opted to pay the $873. I called to talk to the manager about the fee Tuesday morning, was told he would call back. No call back, called again Wednesday still no answer and no call back! I expect to pay some for labor, but $873 for less than an hour of work (we timed the guys) is a little much. They are charging more in labor than what it would have cost me to buy a water heater at Home Depot.

reviews.author: Charles Lane
reviews.text: On 12/31/25 we requested a garbage disposal repair or replacement because we had used this company since they acted as a plumbing subcontractor on a major remodel we did 9 years ago. They came out but couldn’t complete the repair because an “extender” was needed to keep a bolt from pressing on the sink bottom. They didn’t have the part on their vehicle or in stock. They left the sink and dishwasher disconnected so we had to wash dishes in the bathtub. On 1/2 we learned it would be 10 days for the part to arrive. On 1/7, at our request, they reconnected the sink and dishwasher (which should have been done on 12/31).  On 1/13/26 they completed the install and charged $871.65. We paid but requested an invoice and a call from a supervisor. Both were promised but neither an invoice nor a call was forthcoming despite 2 follow up requests. The disposal retails for $114.44 on Amazon so we paid over $750 for labor and an extender. We view the price as horribly excessive and the follow up customer service as nonexistent. New owners acquired the business in the recent past. I guess that explains the now shoddy, overpriced service.

reviews.author: Neko Xon
reviews.text: Premium Plumbing had come highly recommended from a family/friend, selecting this company over four other cheaper plumbers. I contracted them in Dec 2025, then didn't get started until late March 2026, finishing mid-April 2026. What was estimated as a 3-day project, turned into a 4-month nightmare. The horrible communications, terrible customer service and their quality management practices are non-existent. What they had in abundance of was excuses. Shifting the blame onto everyone, accepting themselves. They used a subcontractor (Apex Plumbing), who was just as bad as the parent company. A major red flag that I ignored was the subdivision of their company, which denotes their "grab the money and run" tactic to avoid liability and accountability, if & when they are sued. Although I expected some damage to the backyard and minor delays (city permits). I didn't imagine, nor was I informed that my front yard would also be destroyed due to their poor planning & incompetence. Despite my patience, tolerance, and civility, which were all taken for granted, by these dishonorable, callous, and unprofessional people who were only interested in fleecing the limited money from a disabled USMC veteran caregiver on a fix income in a bad economy. The sad reality is, had I gone with any of the 4 other companies, not only would they have finished faster. But I would have gotten the same quality of work for a fraction of the cost. In the end, because of the inconvenience, bad service, damage, disrespect, and many delays, etc..., Just a few of the many problems experienced, in addition to the 4-month delay, was installing the wrong septic tank. I ordered and was paying for a 1530-gallon tank, but they were going to install a 900 gallon. I got this unethical switch before it was too late. But that then delayed the job another day, on top of the delay because they took Monday off. Then they failed to provide me with the permits, & breaking my concrete patio floor in the backyard, again because of their poor planning. Then they were going to leave the job, with an obvious crater (from where the septic tank/drainage field) in the backyard because they had started late in the day and didn't want to keep returning to properly cover the ground with the dirt that was extracted from the backyard but was relocated to the front. To get anything done properly was like pulling teeth. Don't get me started on their countless lies and false promises. And I am leaving out all of the minor problems. Premium Plumbing only gave me a $500 discount for my troubles out of a $25k bill. If they had only worked as quickly in the service I hired them for as quickly as they issued the bill, then I at least would have been satisfied. But as it is, I am only very disappointed with what this company did and failed to do. In conclusion, I didn't get my money's worth from this truly disgusting immoral and godless company that I warn everyone to stay away from. Don't let what happen to me, happen to you--pick ANYONE but them or their subcontract Apex Plumbing. They cannot be trusted and their word, like work, is worthless.

reviews.author: Virgil Baker
reviews.text:
I called for service on my mother’s leaking kitchen sink which is 2 years old in a new development.  She the only occupant to have lived in the home.  She is a senior citizen who lives in Zephyrhills.  The tech arrived and turned the water off using the valve under the sink. My mother had me on speaker so I could interact with the tech.  He assessed the damage and told my mother he needs to go his truck and write up the cost.

He returned and informed us the bill would be $886 and $443 was required to schedule the appointment.  I put $443 on my card to schedule the appointment.  I contacted the tech after he left my mother’s house and I requested an invoice to show me why a simple leak would cost $886 to repair.  He informed me that they don’t do invoices.

I called the office and canceled the service.  The tech called me back and stated he would speak to his manager to see what he could do. He sent me a text, which I still have, stating he could give me a $100 discount and a cheaper faucet to lower my cost to $739. I let the cancellation stay in place and received the $443 back on my card.

My mother reached out to the sales consultant who facilitated her purchase of the home and she sent an individual who works the plumbing for the development (still building in her area).  He arrived and told my mother nothing was broken or defective.  The assembly was not tightened properly so he grab his tools and corrected the problem.  It took a total of 15-20 minutes from arrival to departure to resolve the issue.  He didn’t want to accept any money from my mother but she insisted.
